title: setting/slots.json, content format 2026-11-15
description: The slots a hero wears items in (decisions 0036 and 0058), in the order a screen lists them: a hero wears one item in each. Each item names its slot by id. A slot's pool is what a pick may choose for it where a mode offers loadouts (PvP in the shipped modes): the items worn there at one of its tiers. A world with a dungeon needs at least one slot, as many as the campaign's gearSlots; [] is a world whose heroes wear nothing.

tiers.description: The item tiers offered: every content item worn in this slot whose tier is one of these.

pool.description: What a pick may choose for this slot where a mode offers loadouts (decision 0058); it must offer at least one item. A slot without one is never chosen.
